cohort: A total of 3046 infants (6092 hips) within 6 months after birth were admitted to a large hospital in northwest China between 2014 and 2018.
finding: The occurrence of DDH is significantly related to gender, hip side, intrauterine fetal presentation, amniotic fluid volume, gestational age, mode of delivery, birth weight, diagnosis age, and maternal age, while its severity is correlated with ethnicity, birth order, birth weight, gestational age, diagnosis age, and maternal age.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a factor related to the occurrence of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH).
